comments.text: One contribution to mediocre food is the fact that Sysco maintains a monopoly over the restaurant industry. To compound matters, Sysco is attempting a takeover of Restaurant Depot, one of their few sources of competition. Our only way to fight high prices is to just order an entree (burger, etc.) and grab a bag of chips and a soda at a convenience store. What passes for "service" these days is an abomination! On my last restaurant outing, after a 40 minute wait, we canceled our order for CHIPS AND SALSA!! How sad is it when a restaurant kitchen can't turn out a plate of chips in less than half an hour? I absolutely see a collapse of the industry in the next decade. I may be wrong, but I predict 60% of today's restaurants will be gone in five years. I'm strongly considering a back yard veggie garden! My grandparents kept pigs and chickens. We had fresh chicken, bacon, sausage, ham and ribs - all we could eat! Their garden had corn, beans, squash, cucumbers, strawberries, etc. To have the means in this country for the best of the best food, and for us to settle for processed food, more appropriate for a science lab, is a tragedy!
